title: Understanding the Model
text: The model used is a linear regression model without regularization. It predicts attendance rate based on distance from the bell and section number.

title: Interpreting the Coefficients
text: In a model without regularization, the coefficients are not penalized. This means the model will choose coefficients that best fit the training data, potentially leading to larger values.

title: Comparing the Versions
text: Compare the coefficients of the three versions. The version without regularization is likely to have larger coefficients because it does not penalize them.
